'''Scov''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], in the [[Alderaan Civil War|civil war]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. When the Republic learned that [[House Ulgo]] was plotting to eradicate the remaining survivors of [[House Panteer]], Scov voiced his objections with his superior, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bradel]], criticizing the Panteers for pulling Alderaan from the Republic.<ref>{{TORcite|type=general|Sudden Death|Alderaan}}</ref>
